question: On the macOS host, are memory, RAG and the other foundation layers current, which models suit the Mac foundation, and what must the replacement Mac pick up?
scope: Assessment and measurement only. This record changed no Mac global state. The single writer of Mac global state and shared foundation services is the foundation-lane-setup session (user decision 2026-09-24, agent-ecosystem#28); changes land there through agent-ecosystem pull requests.

evidence_levels.native_proven: Observed on macos-m5pro-20260924 by the recording session.
evidence_levels.reported_by_owner: Stated on 2026-09-24 by the foundation-lane-setup or mac-coordinator-agent-setup session; not re-read by the recording session.
evidence_levels.existing_record: Already recorded in this repository or in agent-ecosystem at the cited path.
evidence_levels.official_docs_metadata: An official vendor page read live on 2026-09-24.
evidence_levels.live_repository_metadata: Hugging Face API metadata read on 2026-09-24; not quality evidence.

verdict: Partly aligned. The architecture follows current practice (hybrid memory retrieval, local code RAG with a current embedder, per-host indexes, one writer for shared state). No layer is closed as current by this repository's own rule, the memory vector lane is off, there is no reranking stage, and the Mac's embedder is not the measured benchmark winner.

saturation.rule: A layer becomes a candidate after 3 consecutive clean completed sweeps at least 7 days apart; every layer's clean count is 0 because the completed sweep's votes were not retained.

User skills include ecosystem-catalog, qmd, the Tavily skills and playwright-cli.

memory.assessment: The design is current: ai-memory fuses FTS5, entity-match and graph-neighbour results with optional vector RRF. The vector lane is off on the Mac, and ai-memory has not been compared against alternatives (durable-memory is comparison_required).

measured_embedder_ranking.evidence_level: existing_record (one WSL2 host, one run per arm, dense cosine retrieval only)

memory.wiring: ai-memory accepts AI_MEMORY_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=openai-compat with AI_MEMORY_EMBEDDING_BASE_URL, AI_MEMORY_EMBEDDING_MODEL and AI_MEMORY_EMBEDDING_DIM (upstream docs/llm-providers.md on main; confirm on the pinned 2.3.2). Its LLM features (session consolidation, LLM reranking) would summarize sessions automatically, which the user's practice keeps off.

rag.assessment: Code retrieval works (9/10 hit@3), document keyword retrieval is weak (3/10 hit@3), and there is no reranking stage. The two catalogs disagree on the Mac's embedding runtime: agent-ecosystem runs Ollama; catalogs/foundation/decisions.json (macos-embedding-backend) drafts llama.cpp Metal with embeddinggemma-300M-Q8_0. Ollama also survived the 2026-09-23 sweep.

retrieval_smoke.limits: One run per tool, one annotator, questions written after the corpus was known; a smoke check, not a benchmark.

native_clients.openai: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna rolled out to Codex on 2026-09-22, with Codex CLI 0.156.0 the same day (learn.chatgpt.com/docs/changelog, codex-2026-09-22-gpt-6-sol-luna). The catalog default is gpt-6-astra (catalogs/us-equities/models.md, checked 2026-09-19); the Mac runs codex-cli 0.155.0-alpha.16.3 against the Mac pin 0.155.1.
native_clients.anthropic: Claude Opus 5.5 (model id claude-opus-5-5) is in use in native sessions on this host and is not listed in catalogs/us-equities/models.md, whose default is claude-opus-5[1m].

open_items_for_the_replacement_mac: Record the new host through the new-host loop (docs/contributing-evidence.md section 0): hardware_profile.py --record-host with a new host id, then host receipts.

Apply the shared foundation from agent-ecosystem through its single writer (agent-ecosystem#28). Do not also load adoption/bootstrap-macos.sh's launchd agents: they would duplicate the local.agent-ecosystem Qdrant and ai-memory services.

Run the RAM-fit matrix (measurement only, scratch processes; claim on agent-ecosystem#28): Serena 1.7.0, jCodeMunch 1.108.319, mcporter 0.14.1, syft 1.52.0, difftastic 0.71.0, and a scratch llama.cpp b11057 with Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, Nemotron-3-Embed-1B Q8_0, embeddinggemma-300M and Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B against qwen3-embedding:4b. About 2.9 GB of downloads, pending the user's approval.

Compare embedders on frozen questions (Nemotron-3-Embed-1B Mac build with a parity check against the Linux reference vectors, Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, jina-embeddings-v5, against qwen3-embedding:4b), then decide the memory vector lane with the foundation-lane owner.
Compare rerankers on the same questions: jina-reranker-v3.5, Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B and core-reranker-2b.
Decide the pending survivors listed under saturation.
Record GPT-6 Sol and Luna, Codex CLI 0.156.0 and Claude Opus 5.5 as candidates and compare them on a frozen task.
Run the next saturation sweep on or after 2026-09-30 with votes retained.
